name: docslinks-verify
description: Docs '?' affordances render in the command palette and the Tools menu.

steps.name: check-cmdk-help
steps.eval: (function(){var n=document.querySelectorAll('.cmdk-item .ci-help').length;if(n===0)throw new Error('no palette docs help affordances');return 'cmdk-help-'+n})()

steps.name: check-tools-help
steps.eval: (function(){var n=document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-wrap .mi-help').length;if(n===0)throw new Error('no tools-menu docs help affordances');return 'tools-help-'+n})()
